title: Great app
review: Awesome app that helps me stay excited and organized with my friends in this challenge! Recommendations: more description in each step when registering (confusion lors des invitations et synchro entre amis).

title: love love love
review: This simple list made my life so much easier. Being able to check off my daily tasks was easy, especially the water tracker. Everything is modifiable to your needs. Love that it isn't aggressive like some 75 Hard apps — if you forget, it just asks if you're still on track.

title: Great app for my lifestyle
review: Used it as a lifestyle reset rather than extreme challenge. 10k steps, calorie budget. The widget is a huge win — seeing progress front and center kept me motivated. Supports real sustainable habits instead of burnout-level rules.

title: Consistent Developer
review: Great app to track 75 hard. Free options fairly robust. Disappointed by how much is locked behind paid, but dev is consistent with updates. Paid = appreciation for consistent work.

title: Shady Business Practices
review: Bought a plan that ignored my answers and provided AI generated plan that was BS. Login doesn't work consistently. Subscriptions don't appear in Apple subscription manager. Suddenly subscribed for $80/month. No proof of signing up.

title: Helpful and motivating!
review: Perfect for 75 hard. Motivating to see where you stand. Love adding friends and checking off tasks. Best part: lifetime purchase, can use for new challenges or create own baselines.

title: Happy overall - widget needs work
review: Like ability to see current/past days, check-in reminders, customization. On day 20 of 75 medium. Major complaint: widget and app don't talk well. If I cross off on widget, doesn't register in app.

title: Scam
review: Monthly recurring subscription but charging four times a month since January. Can't cancel, no longer connected to Apple ID. Linked to family account. This app is a scam.

title: Could be 5 stars but some flaws
review: When starting a challenge like 75 hard, start and customize options both lead to customize. A complete new challenge pops up instead of the built-in one.

title: Expected more. Somewhat glitchy.
review: Day number constantly glitches to day 1 on widget and app. Pro version should give more widget options. After completing day, only shares to social media (can't customize). Pro mostly gave photo storage, not worth it.
